title: Gentle Stroking Around the Ears
summary: Light movements are made around the outer ear over soft tissue.
instructions: Use the finger pads around the outer ear.
Do not press into the ear canal.
direction: Around the outer ear over soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
